- 2026-10-21 ERRATUM (DFM-CODE-PATHS, TFQ-1100..1137): `code/ravera_dfm_dossier_replay.py` and `rust/ravera_dfm_finite_to_continuum.rs` do not exist in this checkout. The replay is `code/python/src/qm/ravera_dfm.py` (`verify_pillar1_*` to `verify_pillar9_*`, `evaluate_ravera_dfm_dossier`) with tests in `code/python/tests/test_ravera_dfm.py`; the Rust twin is `code/rust/src/qm/campaigns/ravera_dfm.rs`, which calls `evaluate_*_control` functions in the external `omega_quantum_physics` crate; the Lean file is `lean4/RaveraDfmFiniteToContinuum.lean`.
- 2026-10-21 ERRATUM (DFM-ANOMALY-COEFFICIENT, TFQ-1121): Theorem 3.6 item 3 prints the cubic hypercharge trace as (3/4)(3 - N_c). The retained Lean statement `sm_anomaly_polynomials_general_nc` gives (3 - N_c)/4 (value 1/2 at N_c = 1). The [SU(2)_L]^2 U(1)_Y coefficient (N_c - 3)/6 agrees. The companion change log `dag/research/ravera_dfm_changes.md` ('6 A_grav = 6(N_c - 3)') is also inconsistent: the gravitational coefficient vanishes identically.
- 2026-10-21 ERRATUM (DFM-QEM-CONVENTION, TFQ-1118/1119): The dossier uses Q = T_3 + Y with Y_Phi = 1/2, so Q_EM = diag(1, 0) on the doublet and the anomaly table uses Y_Q = 1/6, Y_L = -1/2; the companion `dag/research/ravera_dfm_docs.md` uses Q = T_3 + Y/2. The dossier convention is the one tied to the Lean anomaly table and is retained; the two normalizations must not be mixed.
- 2026-10-21 ERRATUM (DFM-ROOT-CONJUGATION, TFQ-0399): Definition 2.2 states that an unanchored shift acts as U^{dress} -> g(v_0)^{-1} U^{dress} g(v_0). With the stated u_T(v)^g = g(v) u_T(v) g(v_0)^{-1} and U^{dress} = u_T(v)^{-1} U u_T(u), the action is g(v_0) U^{dress} g(v_0)^{-1}, as in TFQ-0399.
- 2026-10-21 ERRATUM (DFM-CLOCK-IDENTITY, TFQ-1116): `dag/research/ravera_dfm_docs.md` writes the Page-Wootters identity as (I_C - S_C) (x) I_S, which disagrees with the dossier (D^dagger W D = S_C (x) I_S) and the code.
- 2026-10-21 ERRATUM (DFM-BIANCHI-GRIBOV-LEAN, TFQ-1106/1130/1131/1136): Lean names cited for the Bianchi identity (sections 3.2, 3.9) and for Gribov-copy elimination (section 3.8) prove weaker statements than the prose: `spanning_tree_nonabelian_mat2_factorization` is one fixed triangle with Mat2Rat links, not B_2(Q), N or T_2(Q); `su3_diagonal_klein_four_landau_gribov_copies` is rational arithmetic on diagonal entries (its Landau term is (d1-d1)+(d2-d2)+(d3-d3) = 0) and `spanning_tree_dfm_eliminates_gribov_copies` works in the commutative group of nonzero rationals, not SU(3); `bianchi_loop` is h1 h2 h2^{-1} h1^{-1} = I in the 2x2 boost plane. The Python replay is the substantive check for sections 3.2 and 3.8; the DFM audited statuses reflect this.
